revisionDesc.change: Submit - BL 7 and 9 integration, one restoration.

Commit - I've integrated BL 7 and 9, for lines 3 and 17 respectively. An additional supplementation: line 8-9 ἐξ αὐ|[-ca.? => ἐξ αὐ|[τῆς -ca.? (here the husband is narrating, cf. Chrest.Mitt. 372 col. 3.15: γυν[αι]κὶ Ῥωμα[ί]ᾳ ἐξ ἧς πεπαιδοποιῆσθαι)

Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Accept. this is a minor typo fix. Finalizer Note XML for supraline lin17 is somehow broken: <hi rend="supraline"> </hi>διευτύχει <hi rend="supraline"> </hi> fix --> <hi rend="supraline">διευτύχει</hi>
deleted superfluous lenis over dieutychei in line 17; marked up overscore over the same.
deleted superfluous lenis over dieutychei in line 17; marked up overscore over the same.
I removed the lenis from upsilon in dieutychei in line 17 and extended supraline to cover chi, as I should have done when I first submitted.
Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Confirmed on APIS image; finalizer add diacriticals to reg.
Vote - AcceptText - Accept. This is a good correction (verified on image). nb, the supraline is there. Corrector forget to remove smooth breathing.

Eutychein is effectively replaced by dieutychein by the second century in petitions, esp. in the Oxyrhynchite, making P.Princ. II 77 an outlyer. On inspecting the image, the initial delta-iota is clearly visible. I therefore corrected eutychei to dieutychei.
batch converted all tei:sic to tei:orig and tei:corr to tei:reg
changed schema; added xml:space=preserve; indented; moved title/@n to idno
Converted from TEI P4 (EpiDoc DTD v. 6) to P5 (EpiDoc RNG schema)
